remarks: Two lots offered together for a combined 1.57 acres at 210 Richards Ave. Build your dream home with a large lot, or subdivide for 2 lots, or put a private road for three lots. Minimum lot size only 12,500 sq ft per zoning. Owner had plans and permits in place to build a new 3,000 square foot 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath home with study/office area attached 2 car garage and partially finished basement. See attached designs by local surveyors and engineers. Subdivisions plans never submitted or approved. Utility easement in place to Coventry Place at rear of property for water/sewer connections. Buyer to do their own due diligence. Owner/Agent Related.
